title: 第21章 齐百春只身退敌第22章 他救他徒弟关我什么事
content_zh:
十里镇西边不远处，有一条河。
这条河，名曰蕊仙河。
取自诗句：十里春风，二分明月，蕊仙飞下琼楼。
传说曾有花仙临凡，在此沐日浴月。
小时候，刘大宝经常拽着陆天明在河里找仙女。
仙女没见着，妇人倒是挺多。
刘大宝非指着她们说，都是仙女。
陆天明说哪是什么仙女，明明都是街坊邻居。
然后，两人便盯着仔细鉴别。
天气好的时候，能在河里泡一天。
再次回到这条河边，陆天明有些许感慨。
陪他泡澡的人，现在还躺床上。
醒是醒了，就是不听劝，药不吃，针不扎。
说什么要是离开十里镇，还不如死了算了。
没辙，忙完这边，还得亲自去劝。
此刻，河边坐着个带斗笠的汉子。
汉子在钓鱼。
用他的长刀。
刀尖处有一豁口。
鱼线正好卡在里面。

“你来了？”北枫没有回头，注意力都在鱼漂上。
陆天明在不远处坐下。
“你约的地方，够特别。”
陆天明捂嘴轻咳。
河边，风大。
“习惯了，热闹的地方不好说话。”
“是不好抛尸吧？”
汉子回头，见到陆天明的第一眼，眼里闪过一丝异色。
年轻，比那年他带兵打仗时还要年轻。
“我做事比较讲规矩，管杀管埋，不像你，杀了不管，等着人来查，找的地方合适，能省不少事。”
陆天明同样在打量北枫。
脖子上的伤疤异常骇人。
眼神凛冽得像大楚长城外的西北狼。
果然，杀过太多人，眼神就会变成冬天房檐上的冰凌，锋利、寒冷。
“一百多号人，怎么埋？”陆天明平静道。
“埋不了，可以烧。”
鱼漂下坠，北枫起竿。
运气不好，鱼线断了。
长刀归鞘，北枫起身问道：“要不要换个地方？”
陆天明摇头：“无妨，老毛病，好不了也死不去，能忍。”
content_en:
Not far to the west of Shili Town, there is a river.
This river is called Ruixian River.
Taken from the poem: Ten miles of spring breeze, two bright moons, Ruixian flew down from the Qiong Tower.
Legend has it that a flower fairy once came to the world to bathe in the sun and moon.
When he was a child, Liu Dabao often dragged Lu Tianming to look for fairies in the river.
There were no fairies, but there were quite a few women.
Liu Dabaofei pointed at them and said, they are all fairies.
Lu Tianming said what kind of fairies were they, they were all neighbors.
Then, the two of them stared at each other carefully.
When the weather is nice, you can spend a day soaking in the river.
Returning to the river again, Lu Tianming felt a little emotional.
The person who took the bath with him is still lying on the bed.
I'm awake, but I just don't listen to advice, don't take medicine, and don't take needles.
He said that if he left Shili Town, he might as well die.
No way, after finishing this work, I have to go and persuade him personally.
At this moment, a man wearing a bamboo hat was sitting by the river.
The man is fishing.
With his long knife.
There is a gap at the tip of the knife.
The fishing line just got stuck inside.
"Are you here?" Bei Feng did not look back, focusing on the fish float.
Lu Tianming sat down not far away.
"The place you made an appointment with is special enough."
Lu Tianming covered his mouth and coughed lightly.
By the river, the wind is strong.
"I'm used to it. It's hard to talk in busy places."
"Isn't it easy to dispose of the body?"
The man turned around, and when he saw Lu Tianming for the first time, a strange color flashed in his eyes.
Young, even younger than when he led the troops to fight that year.
"I'm more disciplined in my work. I'm in charge of killing and burying people. Unlike you, who kills and buries people and waits for people to come and check them out. If you find them in the right place, you can save a lot of trouble."
Lu Tianming was also sizing up Bei Feng.
The scar on his neck was extremely gruesome.
His eyes were as sharp as the northwest wolf outside the Great Wall of Dachu.
Sure enough, if you kill too many people, your eyes will turn into ice on the eaves in winter, sharp and cold.
"How can we bury more than a hundred people?" Lu Tianming said calmly.
"If you can't bury it, you can burn it."
The fish float falls and Bei Feng raises the pole.
Bad luck, the fishing line broke.
After returning the long sword to its sheath, Bei Feng stood up and asked, "Would you like to change places?"
Lu Tianming shook his head: "It doesn't matter, it's an old problem. It won't go away even if it doesn't get better. I can bear it."
